notes: Each case names the section(s) that genuinely answer the question. A retrieval is correct when a returned passage comes from one of them. `absent` cases have no answer in the corpus at all - the system is scored on refusing rather than on retrieving. The distractor documents in sample-docs/distractors exist to make this measurable: they discuss timeouts, retries, backoff, jitter, thresholds and breakers at length while describing different mechanisms, so a question about the gateway now has plausible wrong answers to lose to. Before they existed every configuration scored the same, because k=3 returned a sixth of the corpus.
